name: Klipper (vanilla)
description: Mainline Klipper in place of Anycubic's GoKlipper, with ACE Pro and ACE 2 Pro support and the ACE dashboard. By Kobra-S1. If you have an ACE Pro, it starts out off: turn on the "ACE Pro" switch in Mainsail (or set value: 1 under [output_pin ACE_Pro] in ace_<model>.cfg), and add tool=[initial_tool] to G9111 in your slicer's start G-code.
